QuestInfo.name: Monsters and the Golden Maple Leaf
QuestInfo.0: This may be a time of celebration and reflection, but the monsters don't seem to care! Eliminate 500 monsters everyday during the event period and receive a #t3994385#.
QuestInfo.1: This may be a time of celebration and reflection, but the monsters don't seem to care! Eliminate 500 monsters everyday during the event period and receive a #t3994385#.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated 500 monsters, received a #t3994385#, and made Maple World just a little bit safer for everyone.

0.0: Hey, are you collecting #t3994385# items? If so, could you do a little something for me? I'll give you a #t3994385# if you do.

yes.0: This season has been a time of celebration and reflection for everyone, but monsters have been trying to ruin it. I don't know why they get so aggressive sometimes, but something has to be done about it. If you can eliminate 500 monsters level 151 or above, I will give you one #t3994385#.

no.0: If you won't help, then I guess... I'll just... Hmm.

1.0: Did you mop-up those monsters? It certainly seems more peaceful around here now. Thank you! Here's the #t3994385#, as promised.
